나이아신 : ①체내 에너지 생성에 필요

셀렌 : ①유해산소로부터 세포를 보호하는데 필요

비타민D : ①칼슘과 인이 흡수되고 이용되는데 필요②뼈의 형성과 유지에 필요③골다공증발생 위험 감소에 도움을 줌

(주)서흥 제조 · 1일 2회 3정

이 제품은 나이아신 13.5mg, 망간 1.675mg, 비오틴 22.5μg, 비타민 A 450μg, 비타민 B1 1.05mg, 비타민 B12 1.95μg, 비타민 B2 1.35mg, 비타민 B6 1.35mg, 비타민 C 50mg, 비타민 D 7.5μg, 비타민 E 14mg, 셀레늄 16.5μg, 아연 4.7mg, 엽산 220μg를 표시량으로 담은 14원료 복합 건강기능식품입니다. 각 원료의 공식 인정 기능성은 아래와 같습니다.

  • 1일 2회(3정) 섭취로 나이아신 13.5mg, 망간 1.675mg, 비오틴 22.5μg, 비타민 A 450μg, 비타민 B1 1.05mg, 비타민 B12 1.95μg, 비타민 B2 1.35mg, 비타민 B6 1.35mg, 비타민 C 50mg, 비타민 D 7.5μg, 비타민 E 14mg, 셀레늄 16.5μg, 아연 4.7mg, 엽산 220μg
  • 대장균군 음성 — 식약처 신고 기준 적합
  • 고유의 향미가 있고, 이미. 이취가 없는 흰 점박이가 있는 흰분홍 또는 연한분홍색의 원형 츄어블정제 · (주)서흥 제조

  • 비타민 C
    • 결합조직 형성과 기능유지에 필요
    • 철의 흡수에 필요
    • 항산화 작용을 하여 유해산소로부터 세포를 보호하는데 필요
  • 비타민 D

Made by (주)서흥 · 2 times a day · 3 tablets

This product combines 13.5mg of Niacin, 1.675mg of Manganese, 22.5μg of Biotin, 450μg of Vitamin A, 1.05mg of Vitamin B1, 1.95μg of Vitamin B12, 1.35mg of Vitamin B2, 1.35mg of Vitamin B6, 50mg of Vitamin C, 7.5μg of Vitamin D, 14mg of Vitamin E, 16.5μg of Selenium, 4.7mg of Zinc, 220μg of Folate as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • 2 times a day (3 tablets): 13.5mg Niacin, 1.675mg Manganese, 22.5μg Biotin, 450μg Vitamin A, 1.05mg Vitamin B1, 1.95μg Vitamin B12, 1.35mg Vitamin B2, 1.35mg Vitamin B6, 50mg Vitamin C, 7.5μg Vitamin D, 14mg Vitamin E, 16.5μg Selenium, 4.7mg Zinc, 220μg Folate
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by (주)서흥

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Niacin
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Manganese
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
    • Needed for bone formation
    • Needed for energy utilisation
  • Biotin
    • Needed for the metabolism of fat, carbohydrate and protein and for energy production
  • Vitamin A
    • Needed for the adaptation of vision in dim light
    • Needed to form and maintain skin and mucous membranes
    • Needed for the growth and development of epithelial cells
  • Vitamin B1
    • Needed for carbohydrate and energy metabolism
  • Vitamin B12
    • Needed for normal folate metabolism
  • Vitamin B2
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Vitamin B6
    • Needed for protein and amino acid utilisation
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
  • Vitamin C
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of connective tissue
    • Needed for the absorption of iron
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Vitamin D
    • Needed for the absorption and utilisation of calcium and phosphorus
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of bone
    • Recognised as helping reduce the risk of developing osteoporosis
  • Vitamin E
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Selenium
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Zinc
    • Needed for normal immune function
    • Needed for normal cell division
  • Folate
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
    • Needed for cell and blood formation
    • Needed for the normal development of the fetal neural tube

Directions (exactly as officially stated)

2 times a day3 tablets per servingChew to take

This product combines 13.5mg of Niacin, 1.675mg of Manganese, 22.5μg of Biotin, 450μg of Vitamin A, 1.05mg of Vitamin B1, 1.95μg of Vitamin B12, 1.35mg of Vitamin B2, 1.5mg of Vitamin B6, 50mg of Vitamin C, 7.5μg of Vitamin D, 14mg of Vitamin E, 16.5μg of Selenium, 4.7mg of Zinc, 220μg of Folate as labelled amounts. Why this product

  • 3 times a day (2 tablets): 13.5mg Niacin, 1.675mg Manganese, 22.5μg Biotin, 450μg Vitamin A, 1.05mg Vitamin B1, 1.95μg Vitamin B12, 1.35mg Vitamin B2, 1.5mg Vitamin B6, 50mg Vitamin C, 7.5μg Vitamin D, 14mg Vitamin E, 16.5μg Selenium, 4.7mg Zinc, 220μg Folate
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by 우리바이오(주)

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Niacin
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Manganese
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
    • Needed for bone formation
    • Needed for energy utilisation
  • Biotin
    • Needed for the metabolism of fat, carbohydrate and protein and for energy production
  • Vitamin A
    • Needed for the adaptation of vision in dim light
    • Needed to form and maintain skin and mucous membranes
    • Needed for the growth and development of epithelial cells
  • Vitamin B1
    • Needed for carbohydrate and energy metabolism
  • Vitamin B12
    • Needed for normal folate metabolism
  • Vitamin B2
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Vitamin B6
    • Needed for protein and amino acid utilisation
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
  • Vitamin C
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of connective tissue
    • Needed for the absorption of iron
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Vitamin D
    • Needed for the absorption and utilisation of calcium and phosphorus
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of bone
    • Recognised as helping reduce the risk of developing osteoporosis
  • Vitamin E
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Selenium
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Zinc
    • Needed for normal immune function
    • Needed for normal cell division
  • Folate
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
    • Needed for cell and blood formation
    • Needed for the normal development of the fetal neural tube
